text:
Your vault is encrypted on your device before anything gets sent to our servers. When you type your master password, the app runs it through PBKDF2, a key-derivation function, 600,000 times to produce your encryption key. We do that on purpose. Each password guess becomes slow and expensive, so anyone trying to brute-force your master password has to put in a lot of work for every single attempt.

Your vault is then encrypted with that key using AES-256, an encryption standard trusted around the world. The data can't be read without the right key.

We never see your master password. Our servers only hold your encrypted vault, and to anyone without your key, us included, it looks like random noise. If someone broke into our servers, they'd get scrambled data they couldn't read.

It also means your master password is the only thing that can unlock your vault. Make it long, don't use it anywhere else, and don't share it. We never see it, so keeping it safe is up to you.
